notes: Upstream-clone debugging task (syncthing, issue #10709). The brief deliberately withholds the reproduction: the agent must write its own failing regression test in a real Go codebase, localise a one-character semantics bug in the protocol request-size gate (<= 0 vs < 0) without being told which file, fix it, and prove it with the project's own go test runner. Difficulty raised vs the previous wave by requiring the own-repro deliverable and demanding the full existing protocol suite still pass. Hidden cases exercise the same gate with inputs the upstream regression test does not use (different request ids/names, two consecutive zero-count requests, a zero-count request followed by a normal request on the same connection).
